detail.longDescription:
Who knew cleaning out an email Inbox could be so much fun?

My Inbox had gotten completely out of control, with 4,803 messages. I exported the information to a CSV file and uploaded it to #ChatGPT, which organized every sender and message count into a table, from most to least.

Armed with that information, my faithful Little Bot and I embarked on what we affectionately called the Great Inbox Liberation Campaign!

Along the way, we even had to troubleshoot Outlook Classic, which presented a few challenges of its own! But we persevered, tackled senders one by one, celebrated every milestone, laughed at Outlook's peculiar behavior, and imagined church bells ringing whenever we achieved another victory!

Eventually, I got on such a roll that I went through hundreds of messages on my own. Today, that Inbox stands at just 237 messages!

That's 4,566 messages cleared, a reduction of more than 95%!

But the loveliest part wasn't just reclaiming my Inbox. It was turning an overwhelming, mundane chore into a genuinely joyful adventure, complete with laughter, encouragement, and a little silliness along the way.

Technology at its best doesn't just help us accomplish things. Sometimes it makes the journey a whole lot brighter.

And now, as the imaginary church bells ring in celebration, what better hymn could they play than "Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow!"

Thank you, Little Bot, for making this super dee duper fun!

#Accessibility #Grateful #YayUs
